name: RankSEO AI search visibility
description: Verify the authenticated AI Search Visibility experience from its landing state through form validation, deterministic start failure, realtime ChatGPT and Gemini scan progress, and the completed visibility report.

planSteps.description: Start with a clean signed-out browser session, navigate to /auth/sign-up, and create a new account using a unique email address, a valid name, and the password "RankSEO-Test-2026!".
Verify account creation succeeds and the authenticated dashboard navigation becomes available.
Navigate directly to /ai-search-visibility.
Verify the page displays the "AI Search Visibility" badge, the heading beginning "Check how you rank in", Website, Your brand, and Topic fields, and a disabled "Check AI visibility" button.
Observe the animated platform name for at least six seconds and verify the visible heading rotates between ChatGPT and Gemini with fade transitions.
Verify the landing state displays the benefit cards "Track AI mentions", "Discover trigger prompts", and "Compare competitors", with an illustration in each card.
Expand the "Which AI platforms are checked?" item in the Questions answered section.
Verify the expanded answer states that RankSEO checks ChatGPT and Gemini.
Enter "not-a-url" for Website, "A" for Your brand, and "AI" for Topic without submitting.

Verify inline validation displays "Enter a valid URL", "Use 2+ characters" for the brand, and "Use 3+ characters" for the topic, while the Check AI visibility button remains disabled and no progress card appears.

Configure a temporary browser-level interception for POST /api/search-visibility that returns HTTP 500 with the JSON message "Deterministic visibility start failure". Replace the fields with Website "https://testsprite.com", brand "TestSprite", and topic "AI software testing tools for development teams", then click Check AI visibility.

Verify the landing content is replaced by a destructive alert headed "We couldn't finish this visibility scan", the message "Deterministic visibility start failure" is visible, and the form is enabled again after the request finishes.
Remove the temporary POST /api/search-visibility interception so the next request reaches the real application API.
Submit the same valid Website, Your brand, and Topic values once using the real Check AI visibility action.
Verify duplicate submission is prevented while the request and scan are active: all three fields and the submit button are disabled, and the button displays "Checking visibility".
Verify the failed alert is replaced by a live card headed "Checking your AI visibility" with the message that RankSEO will keep processing if the user leaves the page.

Verify the live card exposes a progress bar between 0 and 100 percent and shows the five stages: Preparing visibility scan, Creating customer prompts, Checking ChatGPT and Gemini, Analysing brand mentions, and Building visibility report.
Wait for the real visibility task to reach a terminal state without refreshing or submitting another scan.
Verify a successful terminal state automatically replaces live progress with a visibility report headed "TestSprite in AI search" and identifies the submitted topic and testsprite.com website.
Verify Visibility overview shows an AI visibility score from 0 through 100 and non-negative values for Brand mentions, Website citations, and Competitors found.
Verify the platform results contain exactly one ChatGPT row and one Gemini row, and each row displays a percentage score, prompts checked, mentions, and citations.

Verify the report says five prompts were checked and Prompt visibility contains five prompt rows, each with a Mentioned or Opportunity status and either ChatGPT, Gemini, both platforms, or No platform.
Verify the generated customer prompts do not contain the audited brand name "TestSprite" or the audited domain "testsprite.com".

Verify the completed report includes Competitor visibility and How to improve your score sections, and that displayed score tones are truthful: below 30 is destructive, 30 through 59 is warning, and 60 through 100 is positive.
Resize the browser viewport to approximately 390 pixels wide while remaining on the completed visibility report.
Verify the search form and completed visibility report remain readable without horizontal page overflow, the Website and Your brand fields stack vertically, and report cards use their mobile layout.
